title: tecoma tronadora
intro: Tecoma tronadora, commonly known as Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, which include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma tronadora include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, and its antipyretic action, reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Tecoma tronadora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
